name: Copy of VSN1 Ableton Master Control
description:
Control your Ableton with VSN1!

Download the control script here: [Grid VSN1 Master Control Script](https://docs.intech.studio/presets/vsn1/Grid_VSN1.zip)


Install the script:
1. Download the 'Grid_VSN1.zip' archive.
2. Extract its contents to the following location on Windows /Documents/Ableton/User Library/Remote Scripts/ or to /Music/Ableton/User Library/Remote Scripts/ on MacOS.
3. You shoud now see a folder in this location called 'Grid_VSN1'.
4. Restart Ableton.
5. In Preferences, under Tempo & MIDI, choose your Control Surface from the dropdown 'Grid VSN1' and then add 'Intech Grid MIDI Controller' for both input and output.
6. Enable 'Intech Grid MIDI Controller' for 'Track' and 'Remote' for inputs and outputs.

--[[@cb]] function setLed(val)for i=0,4,1 do local intensity,lednum=gsc(i,val,0,254),glag(8,i)glp(lednum,2,intensity)end end function setRGB(rgb)for i=0,gec()-2 do ele[i]:glc(1,{rgb})ele[i]:glc(2,{rgb})end end function bRGB(i,rgb)ele[i]:glc(1,{rgb})end function draw_arc(cx,cy,r,R,a1,a2,total_s,c)if a1==a2 then return end local max_span=math.rad(300)local current_span=math.abs(a2-a1)local active_segments=math.floor((current_span/max_span)*total_s)if active_segments<1 then return end local step_angle=max_span/total_s local sweep_dir=(a2<a1)and -1 or 1 local x,y,M={},{},math for i=0,active_segments do local a=a1+(i*step_angle*sweep_dir)x[#x+1]=cx+R*M.cos(a)y[#y+1]=cy+R*M.sin(a)end for i=active_segments,0,-1 do local a=a1+(i*step_angle*sweep_dir)x[#x+1]=cx+r*M.cos(a)y[#y+1]=cy+r*M.sin(a)end ele[13]:ldpof(x,y,c)end

--[[@cb]] T,P,V,CMD="0:0","0","0",{}Val=1 RGB={60,60,60}function htn(hex)return tonumber(hex,16)end function sx_rx(hs)local e=ele[8]if hs:sub(1,10):lower()=="f000223806" then print(hs)local cmd=htn(hs:sub(11,12))CMD[cmd]=true if cmd==1 or cmd==2 or cmd==3 then local h=hs:sub(13,-3)local s="" for i=1,#h,2 do s=s..string.char(htn(h:sub(i,i+1)))end if cmd==1 then T=s elseif cmd==2 then P=s else V=s end elseif cmd==4 then RGB=ARRfy(hs,13,17)e:glc(2,{{RGB[1]*2,RGB[2]*2,RGB[3]*2}})elseif cmd==5 then local msb,lsb=htn(hs:sub(13,14)),htn(hs:sub(15,16))Val=(msb*128)+lsb e:epva(Val)setLed(msb*2)e.sync=true elseif cmd==6 then local msb,lsb=htn(hs:sub(13,14)),htn(hs:sub(15,16))Val=(msb*128)+lsb setLed(msb*2)elseif cmd==8 then local a=ARRfy(hs,13,19)ele[a[1]]:glc(1,{{a[2]*2,a[3]*2,a[4]*2}})end end end self.sysexrx_cb=function(self,header,sysex)if header[1]==13 then sx_rx(sysex)end end gtt(14,10000)
